properties.local_prompts:
Aesthetic: Showroom exhibition vlog, handheld smartphone camera, bright ambient car-show lighting, engaging and realistic UGC style.
[SHOT 1]
Duration: 0.0 - 2.5
Camera Motion: Handheld camera with natural conversational shakiness
Visual Prompt: Starting from the reference frame. The young East Asian woman with long straight black hair sits in the driver's seat of the silver sports car with the door open, wearing her lavender sleeveless tulle dress. She immediately starts speaking enthusiastically with natural mouth movements, waving her right hand actively in a welcoming greeting gesture to the camera.
Audio / Dialogue: [Showroom ambient echo, faint distant murmurs] [年轻女声/自然热情] 人声："嗨家人们！今天在车展现场发现了一台视觉效果超棒的跑车！"
[SHOT 2]
Duration: 2.5 - 5.0
Camera Motion: Static handheld medium shot, no panning away from the woman
Visual Prompt: The camera remains focused on the woman in the seat, keeping her face and upper body clearly in the center of the frame. She leans slightly forward, actively pointing her right hand toward the steering wheel right next to her. Her mouth moves dynamically as she speaks, and her expressive face and lavender dress remain fully visible in the shot.
Audio / Dialogue: [Quiet cabin ambient sound] [年轻女声/自然热情] 人声："看这个科技感满满的方向盘，细节质感真的拉满。"
[SHOT 3]
Duration: 5.0 - 7.5
Camera Motion: Slight handheld framing adjustment, keeping the woman centered
Visual Prompt: The camera maintains a medium close-up of the woman. She pat-gestures with her left hand directly on the leather seat surface she is sitting on, explaining its comfort. Her entire upper body, face, and long black hair remain prominently in the center of the frame, interacting with the car interior.
Audio / Dialogue: [Faint leather rustling sound] [年轻女声/自然热情] 人声："这个真皮座椅不仅包裹感很强，触感也特别细腻。"
[SHOT 4]
Duration: 7.5 - 10.0
Camera Motion: Static handheld close-up with subtle natural movement
Visual Prompt: The camera frames her face. She gives a big, joyful smile and an excited shoulder shimmy, speaking directly to the lens. She waves her hand in a parting gesture, reaching toward the screen as if to stop recording.
Audio / Dialogue: [Digital stop recording click, ambient chatter] [年轻女声/自然热情] 人声："这台车直接进我的梦想清单了！你们觉得怎么样？拜拜！"
